title: Oscillux pass list
description: A declarative, host-agnostic list of render passes for one frame. Hosts execute it; Oscillux only defines and validates it. tools/shader/passes.mjs adds the checks JSON Schema cannot express (references, ordering, uniform names). See docs/shader-toolchain.md.

targets.description: Offscreen render targets. The host's output surface is the reserved output name "screen" and is not listed.

scale.description: Size relative to the output surface, per axis. Default 1.

filter.description: Sampling filter when the target is read. Default linear; reads clamp to edge.

feedback.description: Double-buffered: passes may read <id>.previous, the target's contents at the end of the previous frame. Default false.

clear.description: Linear RGBA the target holds before the first frame (feedback) or before its first write each frame (otherwise). Default [0, 0, 0, 1].

shader.description: A manifest visual (wrapped by tools/shader/wrap.mjs, slots image and prev) or a host post-process shader, named here and supplied by the host.

inputs.description: Shader slot to source: "image" (the host's image input), "<target>" (its contents so far this frame) or "<target>.previous" (a feedback target's previous frame).

output.description: A target id, or "screen" for the host's output surface.

blend.description: How the pass combines with the output's contents. Default replace.

uniforms.description: Per-pass values for host-sourced VisualUniforms members, by name in conformance/packing/visual-uniforms.schema.json: a number for float, an array for vec2 or vec4. Array members cannot be set.
